skills.description_zh:
# 简介
基于 Z-Image Turbo 模型，在本地通过 ComfyUI 从文本提示词生成图片（1024×1024，随机种子），完全本地运行，不调用外部 API。

# 前置条件
**需要提前安装ComfyUI和Z-Image-Turbo 文生图模型。**
- 安装ComfyUI（下载地址：https://comfy.org/zh-cn/download ）
- 下载文生图模型，以下两步**二选一**：
    - 手动运行ComfyUI后，打开模板：“Z-Image-Turbo 文生图”，按照提示下载对应模型。（**推荐**）
    - 直接下载：

      > https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/z_image_turbo/resolve/main/split_files/diffusion_models/z_image_turbo_bf16.safetensors

      放到：~/Documents/ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/z_image_turbo_bf16.safetensors

      ---

      > https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/z_image_turbo/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/qwen_3_4b.safetensors

      放到：~/Documents/ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/qwen_3_4b.safetensors

      ---

      > https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/z_image_turbo/resolve/main/split_files/vae/ae.safetensors

      放到： ~/Documents/ComfyUI/models/vae/ae.safetensors

# 使用方法
  直接告诉我你想生成什么图，触发关键词：
  "帮我生成一张图"
  "本地生成图片"
  提到 "ComfyUI"

# 系统要求
1. macOS m1及以上机型，32GB以上内存/ Windows 11 RTX4060及以上显卡
2. 司内网络（下载模型）
3. 需要本地提前配置Comfy UI及Z-Image-Turbo文生图模型（使用步骤中提到安装方法）
4. 在OpenClaw（内网版）和KnotClaw测试通过
skills.name: ComfyUI的本地生图

skills.description: Identify bird species from an audio OR video file using the BirdNET v2.4 acoustic model. Use when the user provides a media file (mp4/mov/wav/mp3/m4a/etc.) and asks "what bird is this", "识别鸟叫/鸟种", "分辨这是什么鸟", "音视频鸟鸣识别", or wants acoustic bird-call identification. Auto-extracts the audio track (no system ffmpeg required), applies a dynamic geographic/phenological genus-weighting table (not a hard whitelist) covering 400+ genera, and includes a rhythm/churring detector covering BirdNET's blind spots for continuous vocalizations (nightjars, woodpecker drumming). Also detects and flags non-bird sound sources (frogs, insects, ambient noise) instead of silently misreporting them as birds. Supports batch processing of an entire folder of recordings with a standardized priority-tier report for annotation triage. Can generate a spectrogram for verification. Fully portable — no hardcoded machine paths.
